title: Strength SMP
description: This datapack/mod makes it so every kill you gain 1 bonus attack damage (with a cap of 5) and when you get killed you lose 1 bonus attack damage (with a min of 0 bonuses)
body:
This simple datapack/mod adds a mechanic similar to strength SMP. it allows you to gain bonus attack damage when you kill another player (capped at a maximum of 5) and lose bonus attack damage whenever you get killed. (until 0 bonus attack damage)
currently no way to check how much bonus attack damage you have, but I might add that later.
